text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said creditors' and equity holders' committees in the company's Chapter 11 proceedings reached a tentative agreement that could result in approval of it plan of reorganization.

Instead of warrants previously proposed, the tentative agreement proposes Edison shareholders get eight-year-term warrants entitling them to buy up to nine percent of the company's new common stock on a fully diluted bases at a strike price of $16.40 per share, Edison said.
The confirmation hearing for Edison's plan is scheduled for August 14. "After the plan is confirmed, Edision anticipates emerging from Chapter 11 within approximately 30 days," the company said.
Due to the agreement, mailing of the plan and a statement to creditors and shareholders has been delayed until June 27, Edison said.
The deadline for voting by creditors and stockholders and the plan of reorganiation and disclosure statement has been extended until July 28.
Edison Brothers has 1,700 stores in North America operating as JW/Jeans West, Coda, Oaktree, J. Riggings, REPP Ltd Big & Tall and other names.
